name: Fred Meyer Grocery Distribution Center Clackamas OR

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled multi-lane truck entrance off SE Hwy 212. Street View (2019-10) shows an overhead gantry signed LANE 1 / LANE 2 / LANE 3 with STOP signs and a sign reading USE ALL THREE LANES / LEAVE 30 FOOT SAFETY GAP BEHIND TRUCKS.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small blue-roofed booth (~1-2 vehicle footprint) seated in the middle of the gate lanes, visible in both satellite z20 and Street View, controlling the three lanes.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Three inbound lanes confirmed by the gantry lane signage and pavement striping at the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated 2 outbound lanes from the apron width; not separately signed, hence flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Already 3 inbound lanes plus a very wide gate apron with unused paved width - ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep apron between Hwy 212 and the guard booth easily stacks 3+ trucks before the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band. Two large warehouses each present long banks of dock doors along their north faces with trailers backed in; total well into the 100+ range across the complex.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band. A full-width drop-trailer strip runs between the buildings and Hwy 212, plus a large angled-row drop yard east of the east building - hundreds of parked trailers.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lots both north of the buildings and on the east end, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: a west warehouse, an east (solar-roofed) warehouse, and a connecting/cooler building between them, all on one secured property.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks appear concentrated on the north faces of both buildings; could not confirm a physically separate ship vs receive bank, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the dense Clackamas/Portland-metro industrial fabric - Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property in the imagery.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~56 acres computed from the traced perimeter polygon (roughly 640m x 355m core), honest estimate.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Inbound and outbound both pass through the single gantry checkpoint at one point on the property line.
